Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is MedHosp's Privacy Impact Assessment template (MedHosp_PIA_Template_v3.docx) and a short instruction sheet. We are kicking off the vendor DPIA for the Redwood-hosted LLM feature that will process patient referral metadata (hashed user IDs, dates, clinic codes, and free-text notes).

Can you please:
- Confirm whether Redwood will act as a data processor or controller for this integration.
- Complete the PIA template sections on data flow, storage locations, subprocessors, and retention.
- Provide supporting evidence (SOC 2 report cover letter, DPA excerpt, SCCs status, data flow diagram, retention policy excerpt).

We are on a tight timeline and would appreciate a first-pass evidence bundle within 5 business days. If you need to escalate to legal/security we can route internally.

Attachments: MedHosp_PIA_Template_v3.docx, MedHosp_PIA_Template_Instructions.pdf

Best,

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the template and timeline. We can support the PIA.

Planned approach (first pass within 5 business days):
1) Scope confirmation: we will state Redwood acts as a processor for the hosted inference path and controller only for telemetry and internal analytics (we'll call out exceptions).
2) Evidence bundle: initial pack attached (evidence-pack_v1.zip) containing SOC 2 Type II cover letter, DPA extract, and a draft dataflow diagram (redwood_dataflow_mv1.drawio.png).
3) Remaining items: SCCs execution status and subprocessors list (we will provide signed SCCs template and current subprocessors list by Day 4).

Requested from your side: please confirm whether the processing will include any special categories of personal data beyond what you described (e.g., genetic, biometric). Also confirm whether you require processing on Dedicated infrastructure (isolated pool) or Hosted (multitenant).

Attachments: evidence-pack_v1.zip (contains: SOC2_coverletter.pdf, DPA_excerpt.pdf, dataflow_png), redwood_dataflow_mv1.drawio.png

I'll coordinate with Mina (data flows) and Neha (security evidence). If legal needs to review the DPA language we can loop in our contracts team.

Vanessa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the initial evidence pack. A couple of clarifications before we mark the PIA as complete: 

1) Can you confirm the default retention period that Redwood will record in the PIA for processed referral notes from the hosted path? If configurable per-customer, please say so and provide the default.
2) Will the dataflow indicate whether pseudonymization/prefix-hash is applied before tokenization and storage? We need a short description for the risk section.
3) For SCCs — do you have countersigned SCCs available or are they provided as a template pending signature? We will need timeline for countersignature.

If you can answer (1) and (2) in-line here and update the template, we can proceed to legal review. Thanks again — the Drive link works.

Best regards,
Liam O'Connor
